dog.description_text:
Tony has been thrown a few curveballs in his life. Adopted as a puppy, Tony came back to us years later through no fault of his own. He was pretty scared of new people and places, but he made huge strides and is a very brave boy! Once he knows you, he loves you! Tony is looking to be the only pet in the home, and is looking for an adopter willing to come meet him a few times to get him comfortable and ready to go home with you. Bideawee will support you every step of the way, and will even send him home as a foster-to-adopt so we can provide behavioral support and coaching as we help adjust him to your home (since new places can be scary for him).

We'd love to see Tony spend his senior years in a forever home. If you have any questions about him and what adopting him might look like, please reach out to us or stop in during our open hours!

Tony's adoption fee has been paid for by a generous donation from CCP Solutions. If you're interested in this cutie, please view our Adoption Process and then visit the Westhampton Adoption Center!
dog.name: Tony
